source_caption_text:
Even he must’ve thought he was MJ for a second 💀

Looze Cannon is quickly becoming one of the internet’s most talked-about Michael Jackson impersonators, mixing comedy, music, livestreaming, and his own unique personality into the character. The Detroit entertainer has gone viral for his MJ-inspired performances and freestyles, even catching the attention of major names like Cordae and Timbaland. Beyond the impersonation, Looze has built a following through his energetic livestreams and comedic content, turning the “Big Michael Michael” persona into a viral internet character of its own. 

Via @wholesome_pop
